meta.name: Ajwaa
meta.tagline: الطقس والوقت، أينما كنت — Weather & time, wherever you are
meta.author: Mohamed Ibrahim Mustafa
meta.purpose: Machine-readable description of Ajwaa's software structure, module responsibilities, data flow, storage, external dependencies and quality gates.
audience: automation that needs to inspect layers or endpoints

stateManagement.why: Compile-safe, testable overrides for network and storage, and no build_runner step to keep the repository reproducible.

persistence.why: Small JSON documents only; no database is needed and the web target gets localStorage for free.

networking.why: Minimal surface, mockable with http/testing MockClient, works on every platform.

localization.why: First-party generation: no extra dependency and type-safe getters.

fonts.source: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, static weights 300-700, bundled under assets/fonts
fonts.why: One family covers Arabic and Latin, so both locales share rhythm and vertical metrics.

android.reasonNotBuilt: Android SDK not installed on the development machine

principles.statement: presentation -> state -> data -> domain -> core. A layer may only import from layers to its right.
principles.enforcedBy: review + the fact that domain/ imports nothing from Flutter, data/ or presentation/

principles.statement: Business rules (units, WMO codes, dust/UV/AQI classification, alert thresholds, distance) are plain Dart with no Flutter imports.
Every external boundary (HTTP payload, disk payload, preferences) is parsed defensively and degrades instead of throwing.
The cache stores raw API JSON, never serialized domain models, so offline data always passes through the same tested parsers as live data.
No user-visible string is hard-coded in a widget; layout uses start/end and directional icons so RTL is automatic.
All values are stored and computed in metric; imperial conversion happens only in the formatter consumed by widgets.
There is no API key, token or backend. The app is fully usable after a clone.

layers.name: core
layers.responsibility: Cross-cutting foundations with no knowledge of weather.

modules.notes: App name, version, public URLs and every storage key in one place.
Offline starter list (Cairo first) so the first launch never shows an empty screen.
Typed failure with kinds: network, timeout, server, rateLimited, malformed, permission, locationUnavailable, unknown. Localized into copy by lib/core/utils/localized_text.dart.
JSON GET with 18s timeout, 3 attempts, retry only for network/timeout/5xx/429 with linear backoff, utf8.decode(bodyBytes, allowMalformed: true), and a descriptive User-Agent.
Light and dark ColorScheme, text theme bound to PlexArabic, and a context extension exposing colors/spacing/texts.
Temperature, wind, distance, precipitation, percent, clock from UTC offset, weekday/month names, relative 'updated x ago' and day labels. Western digits for numbers in both locales.
Total functions: they never throw on missing or mistyped keys.
Maps domain enums and failures to localized copy.
Shared interaction and motion primitives.

layers.name: domain
layers.responsibility: Pure rules and vocabulary. No Flutter, no I/O.

modules.notes: metric | imperial; temperature, wind, distance and precipitation conversion plus code round-trip.
Maps WMO 4677 codes to a small condition enum (clear, partlyCloudy, cloudy, fog, drizzle, rain, heavyRain, snow, thunder, hail) used by glyphs, scenes and copy.
Rules engine, see alertRules below. Output is sorted by severity then kind.
Haversine distance used for storm proximity and cache invalidation.

layers.name: data
layers.responsibility: Talk to the outside world: models, parsers, services, stores and the repository that merges them.

modules.notes: id, name, lat/lon, country, admin1, countryCode, timezone, isCurrentLocation. Identity is the id, so list operations are cheap.
The single view model consumed by the UI. Carries timezoneId, utcOffsetSeconds, fetchedAt, stormsAvailable and isFromCache.
name, coordinates, windKmh, distanceKm, alert level, source link and observation time.
localeCode, unitSystem, themeMode, hasSeenWelcome. Unknown enum names coerce to safe defaults.
Open-Meteo current/hourly/daily -> CurrentWeather, HourlyPoint[], DailyPoint[]. Derives dew point (Magnus), visibility from the nearest hourly point and current UV from the daily maximum.
Extracts dust, PM10, PM2.5, US/EU AQI, UV plus hourly dust and PM10 keyed by epoch second for chart and per-hour joins.
Normalizes both NASA EONET and GDACS shapes, converts knots to km/h, computes distance and sorts by proximity.
Builds the Open-Meteo forecast query (current, hourly, daily, timezone=auto) and returns the raw map.
Open-Meteo air-quality query; optional, failure degrades the dust section instead of the screen.
Open-Meteo geocoding search (language-aware, de-duplicated) and BigDataCloud reverse geocoding with timezone extraction.
NASA EONET first; falls back to GDACS when EONET is empty or unreachable.
geolocator wrapper: permission flow, current position, openSettings().
Reads/writes AppSettings; corrupt or foreign-shaped data falls back to device-language defaults.
Persists the city list and selection; malformed entries are skipped and a dangling selectedId is repaired.
Raw-payload cache keyed by city id, pruned to the 8 most recent entries; writes are best-effort.
Orchestrates forecast + air quality + storms, merges them into WeatherBundle, applies the freshness/location cache policy and serves stale data when offline.

layers.name: state
layers.responsibility: Riverpod wiring and controllers. The only layer widgets talk to.

modules.notes: Every dependency is a provider, so tests override only preferences and two HTTP clients.
setLocale, setUnitSystem, setThemeMode, markWelcomeSeen; writes through SettingsStore on every change.
Add/remove/select cities, deduplicate by id, persist, keep Cairo as the offline default.
AsyncNotifier keyed on the selected city: load, force refresh, expose AppFailure to the error view.
idle -> locating -> found|failed; resolves GPS, reverse-geocodes and hands the City to CitiesController.

layers.name: presentation
layers.responsibility: Widgets, screens, sheets, theme palettes and illustrations. Stateless where possible.

modules.notes: Composes the whole page, owns the 10-minute refresh timer, pull-to-refresh, welcome scheduling and the atmospheric background.
City chip, live condition, temperature, feels-like, high/low, local clock and refresh action.
Renders buildWeatherAlerts output with severity colours; tap for the explanation sheet.
Horizontal 24-hour strip with temperature, condition glyph, rain chance and wind.
Dust concentration and 24-hour curve, PM10/PM2.5/AQI, rain probability/total and the next-wet-hour strip.
Humidity/dew point, wind and gusts, rain chance, UV, pressure, visibility, cloud cover with classifications.
Active cyclones with distance, wind and alert badge; explains the source and the empty state.
7-day rows with week-normalized temperature range bars and per-day detail sheet.
Attribution links, version and the key-less data note.
Shimmer placeholder mirroring the real layout to avoid layout shift.
Localized failure message with retry.
380 ms debounced search, saved cities, popular chips, GPS tile, dismissible removal.
Theme, units and language segmented buttons, plus privacy, data sources, about and licenses.
First-run choice: allow location, pick a city, or continue without; remembers the decision.
Generic explainer sheet so every number can describe what it means.
Vector brand mark, animated atmosphere, condition glyphs, sun arc, ticking clock, charts.
Maps condition + day/night to background gradients and accent colours.

ensureInitialized -> initializeDateFormatting (localized DateFormat) -> SharedPreferences -> ProviderScope override -> runApp. Preferences are resolved before the first frame so language and theme never flash.
MaterialApp with generated title, locale from settings, both themes, Global*Localizations delegates and a scroll behaviour that accepts mouse, stylus and trackpad.

coldStart: main() initializes the binding and intl date symbols.
SharedPreferences is read once and injected through sharedPreferencesProvider.
SettingsController reads AppSettings; a corrupt payload falls back to the device language.
CitiesController restores the saved list, or seeds kSuggestedCities with Cairo selected.
WeatherController loads the selected city: fresh cache (< 10 min and < 5 km) short-circuits the network.
The first frame renders the skeleton; the resolved WeatherBundle replaces it with a Reveal animation.
If hasSeenWelcome is false the welcome sheet is presented once.
refresh: Sources: 10-minute Timer in HomeScreen, pull-to-refresh, the hero refresh button, and a change of selected city.
WeatherRepository.load runs forecast, air quality and storms concurrently; air and storms are optional.
The merged payload is written to the raw cache, then rendered.
Any failure with a compatible cached payload yields the cached bundle flagged isFromCache and shows the offline banner.
citySelection: weatherProvider rebuilds for the new city; the sheet closes and the hero cross-fades.
location: LocationController.locate -> LocationService permission flow -> geolocator position
The city is upserted in CitiesController and selected.

dataFlow.direction: UI -> controller -> repository -> services -> HTTP; responses -> parsers -> models -> repository -> controller -> UI

merge.joinKey: epoch seconds, so hourly dust/PM10 align with hourly forecast points
merge.degradation: A missing optional source removes only its section; stormsAvailable records whether the cyclone source responded.

derived.dewPoint: Magnus formula from temperature and relative humidity
derived.visibility: nearest hourly visibility value to the current observation
derived.currentUv: daily uv_index_max when the air-quality source has no current UV
derived.alerts: computed in the domain layer from the merged bundle

alertRules.firesWhen: current >= 2.5 mm or next 6 h >= 10 mm
alertRules.severeWhen: current >= 8 mm or next 6 h >= 25 mm

cache.payload: raw forecast, air quality and storm JSON plus fetchedAt and the coordinates they belong to
cache.why: Reparsing keeps one code path and lets parser fixes immediately apply to cached data.

storage.backend: SharedPreferences (Android SharedPreferences, iOS NSUserDefaults, web localStorage with the flutter. prefix)

keys.shape: { fetchedAt, latitude, longitude, forecast, air, storms }

storage.migration: Keys are version-suffixed (.v1); unknown enum values and unparseable payloads fall back to defaults instead of crashing.

externalApis.failureMode: Terminal AppFailure; the screen shows a localized retry view unless a compatible cache exists.
Section-level degradation; dust and air cards hide, the rest of the app keeps working.
Inline error inside the city sheet; retry by editing the query.
Falls back to a coordinate-labelled current-location city.
Cyclone section shows an unavailable state; alerts simply omit storms.

failureHandling.model: AppFailure(kind, debugMessage) crossing layers; no raw exceptions reach widgets.
failureHandling.retryPolicy: 3 attempts for network/timeout/5xx/429 with linear backoff; malformed responses are never retried.
failureHandling.uiMapping: lib/core/utils/localized_text.dart -> failureMessage(l10n, error), rendered by ErrorView with a retry action.
failureHandling.storagePolicy: Writes are best-effort and wrapped; reads validate shape and fall back.

localization.direction: automatic from locale; widgets use Directionality-aware alignment and directional icons
localization.numerals: Western digits in both locales for measurements, times and percentages
localization.dateNames: month and weekday names localized via intl after initializeDateFormatting()
localization.keys: ~200 ARB messages covering every visible string, tooltip and semantic label

theming.atmosphere: WeatherScene animates clouds, rain, stars and sun glow based on condition and day/night; reduced-motion friendly.

branding.concept: A sun that doubles as a clock, with a cloud and two rain drops: weather plus time.
branding.generator: tool/render_branding_test.dart (renders the same painter at 1024 px)
pipelines: flutter_launcher_icons (Android adaptive + monochrome, iOS, web, favicon)

suites.covers: forecast, air quality, storm (EONET + GDACS) and geocoding parsing, including gaps and wrong types
every alert rule, severity escalation and ordering
unit conversion, localized formatting and dust/UV/AQI classification
fresh cache, offline fallback, 5 km invalidation, force refresh, malformed payload, cache round trip, key naming
corrupt/partial settings and cities payloads, enum coercion, snapshot round trips
English and Arabic home rendering, RTL directionality, offline error view
settings changes (theme/units/language), city search + add, welcome flow, data-source and about sheets, corrupt-storage boot

isolation.widgets: fixed-frame pumps instead of pumpAndSettle because scenes, shimmer and the clock animate forever

testing.manual: Web build inspected in a real browser at 1296x886 in English/dark and Arabic/light, scrolled through every section.

commands.branding: flutter test tool/render_branding_test.dart && dart run flutter_launcher_icons && dart run flutter_native_splash:create

build.ci: .github/workflows/web.yml builds the web target and publishes to GitHub Pages on pushes to main

privacy.dataAtRest: preferences, saved cities and the last raw payload, on device only
privacy.dataInTransit: coordinates and city names sent only to the public APIs listed above, over HTTPS

add ARB copy and a localized_text mapper
insert it in HomeScreen's section list
